author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The Miniloong Pocket 1 has been out for a few months, and we have new software options that totally transform the user experience. Let's take a look at the Leaf custom firmware and how it makes this handheld one of the best options right now under $100.

My initial review: https://youtu.be/a1rYVHALObw

Buy one here:
GoGameGeek: https://tidd.ly/4dLWAO2
use code RGC15 for 15% off

Amazon (more expensive): https://amzn.to/4g0dtUK

Leaf OS: https://leaf.game/
Leaf discord: https://discord.gg/q5F7cZ7KRp
Five Game Handheld video: https://youtu.be/t2rMB5z9dQw

Other Miniloong Pocket 1 custom firmwares:
